review.decision: Harden Go core event/state atomicity, hqnudge archival and draft holds, hub/radar/transcript/attach hot paths, HTTP/SSE/APNs boundaries, and HQ/mine/codex-frontend/serve parity
review.notes: Covers approved Batch A + Batch B items 1.2, 1.3, 1.4-Go, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 5.1, 5.2, and 5.3-Go in isolated Go unit/component tests without touching real ~/.local/share/gtmux or ~/.config/gtmux.

cases.description: hqnudge archives aged or excess terminal wake files and retires uncertain native intents and pins, reconciles aged colliding slots cleanly, and holds draft or question refusals without permanent retry exhaustion
cases.setup: Create isolated temp HOME directories with terminal .refused/.native-uncertain/.legacy-uncertain files beyond retention bounds, aged colliding X.sending + X.native-uncertain slots, and native wake drains returning InputDraftPresent or InputQuestion.
cases.action: Run Drain/drainInto recovery, terminal archival, colliding-slot reconciliation, and repeated draft/question refusal retries.
cases.expected: Aged or excess (>32 or >24h) terminal wake files are archived into bounded JSONL segments while retiring uncertain nativeIntent JSON and .pin anchors well below the 200/1600 budgets; aged colliding slots archive the older retained file with both digests, settle the pending claim, and allow clean recovery to clear claim-conflict; and InputDraftPresent/InputQuestion refusals requeue with bounded backoff without exhausting into .refused after three attempts.

cases.description: events.Append serializes sequence allocation, rotation, and append under one flock, while markers, watermarks, tasks, and outcome tallies update atomically without truncation races or lost outcomes
cases.setup: Configure isolated temp HOME state with a small events cap, concurrent appenders, missing vs corrupt consumed-seq watermarks, concurrent task mutations, and concurrent AddOutcome/ConsumeTick calls.
cases.action: Run parallel events.Append across rotation boundaries, hqwake.Consumed/Consume, dispatch.AddTask/SetDisposition/SnoozeTask, and hqwake.AddOutcome/ConsumeTick.
cases.expected: Concurrent appends commit contiguous in-order Seq records across rotation without double-rotating events.1.jsonl or triggering false sequence-gap flags; markers and task JSON files publish atomically via private temp+rename; Consumed distinguishes missing (-1) from corrupt/empty (0) and serializes monotonic Consume; and ConsumeTick renames tally.log under lock so concurrent outcomes are never lost.

cases.description: events.ReadSince and events.Read scan backwards from the active tail before touching rotated history while preserving ordering and gap detection, and workspace reconciliation short-circuits caught-up event cursors
cases.setup: Populate multi-chunk events.jsonl and events.1.jsonl fixtures covering active-only tails, cross-rotation tails, leading/internal sequence gaps, legacy seq=0 records, and caught-up hqworkspace event cursors.
cases.action: Execute ReadSince(cursor), Read(sinceSecs, now), and ingestWorkspaceObservations when cursor >= CurrentSeq().
cases.expected: Tail reads return identical oldest-first records and gap verdicts without scanning events.1.jsonl when events.jsonl already reaches Seq <= cursor or Ts < cutoff, fall back across events.1.jsonl when needed, and skip ReadSince entirely in workspace reconciliation when cursor >= CurrentSeq().

cases.description: OnTally dispatches silent badge pushes asynchronously, hub.run executes onSlowTick in a single-flight goroutine followed by checkServerMode without blocking fast/radar/ping ticks, and Collection.Agents memoizes its pane snapshot within one collection
cases.setup: Construct a PushManager with a blocking relay, a hub with a blocking onSlowTick and fast tick/status/awake hooks, and a radar Collection shared across ordered sweeps.
cases.action: Invoke OnTally, run hub while onSlowTick blocks, and call Collection.Agents multiple times alongside Digest.
cases.expected: OnTally returns without waiting on relay badge HTTP calls; hub continues firing radar ticks, fast ticks, and pings while single-flight guarding overlapping slow ticks and running checkServerMode when each slow tick completes; and Collection.Agents memoizes its pane slice per Collection while Digest still resamples fresh content.

cases.description: idleSince short-circuits marked non-Codex panes, transcript caches log paths/errors/titles by stat identity and uses O(1) AgySessionTitle, /api/transcript short-circuits matching If-None-Match before byte-budget marshaling and strips struct context without re-unmarshaling, push status source uses cached snapshots, and tmux commands enforce bounded timeouts
cases.setup: Seed non-Codex finished markers, Claude/Codex/Agy transcript fixtures, HTTP /api/transcript conditional GETs with and without context=1, multi-device done push alerts, and a hanging fake tmux binary.
cases.action: Query idleSince, LastMessageError, SessionTitles, native Agy row titles, /api/transcript with If-None-Match, PushManager done alerts, and tmux.Run under timeout.
cases.expected: Marked non-Codex idle panes return immediately without transcript reads; unchanged files hit stat-keyed caches and native Agy rows read only their own .pbtxt title; conditional GETs return 304 with accurate metadata headers without marshaling turn budgets while public reads strip Context on structs; done alerts reuse cached snapshots; and hung tmux commands time out cleanly.

cases.description: GET /api/attach enforces WebSocket ping/pong read/write deadlines and frame size limits to reap dead clients on quiet panes, while gating AttachCursor sampling on pause state, idle quiescence, and predict=0 opt-out
cases.setup: Start an isolated /api/attach server with a quiet PTY command, controllable ping/idle intervals, and a counting AttachCursor callback.
cases.action: Connect clients that stop answering pings, send oversized frames, pause flow, sit idle past quiescence, or pass predict=0 via connect attach URL.
cases.expected: Unresponsive or oversized WebSocket peers are closed promptly and their PTY child processes reaped even when the pane prints nothing; AttachCursor never forks when predict=0, while paused, or once idle quiescence is reached, and resumes on fresh activity when prediction is enabled.

cases.description: SSE streams disconnect revoked devices and expired guests on subsequent events, /api/addresses rejects guests, guest radar strips host paths/icons, JSON POST handlers bound body sizes and push token lengths, and PushManager retires dead iOS APNs tokens and hashes oversized native collapse IDs
cases.setup: Configure an isolated Server with EnrollManager, ShareManager, PushManager, and HTTPRelay returning APNs 410, 400 BadDeviceToken, and 400 PayloadTooLarge responses.
cases.action: Revoke/expire tokens on open /api/events streams, call /api/addresses and /api/agents as guest, POST >64 KiB JSON bodies and >512-byte push tokens, dispatch iOS pushes, and compute native collapse IDs >64 bytes.
cases.expected: Revoked device and expired guest SSE streams close on the next event/ping; /api/addresses returns 403 to guests; guest /api/agents omits cwd, icon, and launch_host; oversized POST bodies and >512-byte tokens return 400; iOS tokens are retired on 410 or 400 BadDeviceToken but retained on other errors; and oversized native collapse IDs hash to <=64 ASCII hex bytes.

cases.description: HQ board enforces UTF-8 truncation, size/line warnings, and playbook v70 handoff caps; snapshots read validated receipts without double-decompressing archives; private inspection and hygiene handle codex-frontends symlinks and retired entries; hqworkspace logs error details; mine serializes and bounds ledgers with fast LastPassAt and error backoff; prompt normalizes agent labels and all startup choosers; and /api/send marks undelivered tasks, audits non-user actors, and batches pane metadata
cases.setup: Prepare isolated HQ boards (multibyte boundary + >32 KiB/>250 lines), automatic snapshots, codex-frontends client sockets and >128 retired receipts, failing workspace ops, corrupted/large mine ledgers, display-label prompt frames, and /api/send calls from non-user actors on undelivered tasks.
cases.action: Run Board/OversizeBoard/rowHQBoard/selfCheckSensor, Snapshot, InspectPrivateTree/diskHygieneSweep/ConversationRecord, workspace op logging, mine.Run/mineSensor, BootBannerLine/WaitingOptions, and sendToPaneObserved/handlePane.
cases.expected: Board truncates cleanly on valid UTF-8 runes and flags >32 KiB or >250 lines while playbook v70 caps handoff entries to 10; managedSnapshotPoints validates receipts without reading tar.gz archives twice; valid codex-frontends socket symlinks pass inspection while dead sockets and retired receipts are reaped/ignored past 128 files; hqworkspace logs error attributes; mine locks, bounds emitted IDs, reads LastPassAt cheaply, and backs off on errors; prompt matches display labels and all registered choosers; and /api/send marks delivered tasks, audits non-user actors, and reads width+cursor in one tmux query.
